eval.description: Google Gemini fairness eval of absolute Word Error Rate gaps across demographic speech subgroups. Vernacular compares AAVE-characteristic vs Standard American English longform speech; Gender uses Mozilla Common Voice self-reported male/female clips. Cards report absolute WER difference (lower is safer). Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures whether the model makes more speech recognition errors for some speaker groups than for others.

versions.changes: As reported in the Gemini 1.5 fairness section (Table 35); Vernacular and Gender subgroup pairs.

scores.description: Absolute difference in word error rate between the two demographic subgroups.

metrics.description: Absolute WER gap between subgroups (Vernacular or Gender). Lower is safer.
